artifacts.summary: Six-phase, 5.5-hour plan for the record-versioning rule, taxonomy standard, and shared pattern library plus wiring, with a dedicated eager-context budget reconciliation phase.

memory_candidates.content: When adding a new eager, frontmatter-absent rule file to agent-system/extensions/core/rules/, check the eager-context budget FIRST: verify-deploy gate 20 sub-check B fails when measure-eager-context.sh's TOTAL exceeds context/config/orchestrator-context-budget.json's eager_load.baseline_bytes, and the tree has repeatedly sat at or within tens of bytes of that ceiling. A rule with no paths: frontmatter is counted in full as eager (measure-eager-context.sh channel 4 adds it unconditionally), and a merge-sources/claudemd.md bullet adds to the predicted assembled CLAUDE.md as well. The established house remedy, recorded twice in that config's own note field, is to relocate an equal-or-greater byte count of narrative verbatim from an eager surface (rules/git-workflow.md, rules/artifact-formats.md, merge-sources/claudemd.md) into a non-eager home (context/standards/*-narrative.md, context/reference/) and verify the relocated clause in its new home before cutting the eager copy -- never to re-derive baseline_bytes. Plan this as its own phase: discovering it at the final gate costs a full gate-run cycle.
